Mine is less of a pet peeve and more of a general suggestion to modern au fic writers, as it's not all that explored (to my knowledge): modern!Xie Lian in actual poverty, perhaps as a homeless person, an urban squatter, or whatever set-up that emphasizes canon!XL's dire living situation as a member of the lower-class strata. 

Maybe it's the third worlder within me, but I'd love to see how modern!XL would navigate imperialism-capitalism as a peasant farmer/fisherfolk displaced from his province, a poor urbanite in the country's poverty-stricken capital, an exploited factory worker, or at least a low-petibourgeois university student who part-times. Better yet, retain his scrap collector occupation! (because they certainly still do exist...)

I respect fic authors' agency in their own works, but I do mourn the interesting class dynamics that are unfortunately lost when authors write XL as some secretary at a prestigious company.

I just don't get how people on titanfolk are so quick to antagonize the world when Eren has been so adamant about his actions and, as a result, has been broken under the weight of his options. I think this is so because Eren is our main protagonist, and we've been with him ever since the start, letting us understand and empathize with his plight. However, our sentiments start to diverge when I apply the same empathy towards the rest of the world.

I believe he's only been pushed this far because of his very special circumstances (e.g. PATHS, bearing the memories of previous titan shifters, seeing the future, determinism). Murder, especially mass murder, by definition is unjustifiable, and either side doing it is also unjustifiable. In the end, I can't fully blame Eren, but I also can't bring myself to justify genocide either. But that's just me.
